name: cogno-praxis
summary: The Cogno business verticals as standalone MCP servers (the product layer). Each vertical is an independent FastMCP server the host orchestrates via cogno-mcp; verticals own their domain logic + data behind their own store ports. Verticals: scheduler (agenda → SECRETARY persona), bookkeeper (finance → BOOKKEEPER persona), coordinator (academic schedule) and companies (brand registration, transversal).
author: Vinicius Vale
